title: Decision Table: HostCover Pet-Damage Settlement and Escalation Timing
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover) pet-damage claims.** The pet escalation share follows the calendar days from the date part of the guest's response deadline to the date part of the host's escalation of the pet-damage claim: an escalation 22 to 30 days after the deadline settles the pet damage at 85 percent, one 8 to 21 days after at 95 percent, and one 7 days or fewer after in full. The percentage applies to the pet-damage loss being settled, before any guest payment or deductible comes off it.

| Input: calendar days from the deadline's date to the escalation's date | Judgement | Pet damage settled at |
|---|---|---|
| 7 or fewer | 7 days or fewer | in full |
| 8 | 8 to 21 days | 95 percent |
| 21 | 8 to 21 days | 95 percent |
| 22 | 22 to 30 days | 85 percent |
| 30 | 22 to 30 days | 85 percent |

Hypothetical: a guest response deadline at 08:00 on 20 September and an escalation at 19:30 on 12 October are 22 calendar days apart by date, so the pet damage is settled at 85 percent; an escalation on 11 October, 21 days, at 95 percent.
